scope: Authorized single-room bot/action diagnostic; no join-triggered outreach

receive.enclosing_message_is: original bot question, not user input

unresolved: Query auth is required in the table; send examples also add Authorization, while quiz code uses query only. Exact header requirement unresolved.
Webhook signature/authenticity, replay and retry guarantees are not established.
Button definition ID must not be treated as a unique click occurrence.
Actual plan/room/bot authorization, provider egress, callback and peer delivery are untested.

capture_guidance.browser_har_limitation: Browser HAR usually cannot contain backend-to-provider bot sends or server-to-server webhooks.
capture_guidance.when_needed: Only for an authorized staging flow; do not repeat sends just to probe authentication.
capture_guidance.safe_input: Keep raw traces in ignored runtime storage; never upload keys, cookies or private transcripts.
capture_guidance.webhook_evidence: Use a separately redacted consenting test fixture; HAR metadata cannot prove click uniqueness or callback authenticity.
